title: Microsoft Teams: granular channel notification controls
summary: The briefing passes: its rollout dates, default state and controls are supported, and the cited Learn pages open successfully. Two minor corrections remain: name the general Teams licensing requirement and move the Graph request-body setting into the control note.

claims.claim: Roadmap item 565132 concerns granular channel notification controls in Microsoft Teams.
claims.quote: "id": 565132, "title": "Microsoft Teams: Granular channel notification controls"

claims.claim: Users get three per-channel notification presets named All new messages, Mentions and replies, and Mute.
claims.quote: Users will now be able to control their channel notification settings using three presets: All new messages, Mentions and replies, and Mute.

claims.claim: Users can customize the selected preset for unfollowed threads.
claims.quote: Users can further customize the selected preset to manage notifications for unfollowed threads, tag mentions, channel mentions, and team mentions within each channel

claims.quote: Users can further customize the selected preset to manage notifications for unfollowed threads, tag mentions, channel mentions, and team mentions within each channel

claims.claim: The supplied description describes changes to notification preferences, not new data access.
claims.quote: Microsoft Teams introduces flexible presets for channel notifications, allowing you to choose between All new messages, @mentions and replies, or Mute.

claims.claim: The notice mentions no new permissions, roles or sign-in behavior.

claims.where: controls[0]; Why it matters; Risk assessment; Governance controls; Open questions
claims.claim: No tenant-level admin UI or policy API for the channel notification presets is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams granular notification policy; Teams channel notification presets admin role configure policy PowerShell. Opened Teams settings and policies reference, Set-CsTeamsNotificationAndFeedsPolicy and Set-CsTeamsChannelsPolicy; none documents preset controls.

claims.claim: The printed Intune path reaches Org data notifications in a Teams app protection policy.
claims.quote: navigate to Apps > Protection. ... Create Policy ... select your desired platform ... Basics ... Apps ... Select public apps ... Microsoft Teams ... On the Data Protection page, find the Org data notifications setting

claims.claim: The beta PATCH operation updates the iOS policy's notificationRestriction to blockOrganizationalData.
claims.quote:
PATCH https://graph.microsoft.com/beta/deviceAppManagement/iosManagedAppProtections/{iosManagedAppProtectionId}
"notificationRestriction": "blockOrganizationalData"
claims.fix: Set controls[1].api.call and the rendered call to 'PATCH https://graph.microsoft.com/beta/deviceAppManagement/iosManagedAppProtections/{iosManagedAppProtectionId}'. Add to its note: 'The request body sets notificationRestriction to blockOrganizationalData.'

claims.where: controls[1].governs; Risk assessment: Data exposure; Governance guidance; Governance controls
claims.claim: Intune app protection policies govern display or suppression of Teams notifications on iOS and Android, including lock-screen content.
claims.quote: They appear on home screen or lock screen based on the settings. Use the following options to configure your notifications on the portal through an app protection policy.

claims.where: controls[1].note; Risk assessment: Data exposure; Governance controls; Open questions
claims.claim: Microsoft has not documented how the new channel banner options interact with the general mobile notification control.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams channel notification presets Intune; Teams granular notification policy. Opened configure-teams-mobile and the beta iosManagedAppProtection update reference; neither describes interactions with the new presets or banner options.

claims.claim: The Teams settings reference lists one setting under Notifications and feeds, concerning suggested feeds.
claims.quote:
#### Notifications and feeds
| Setting | Default | Description |
| Suggested feeds can appear in a user's activity feed | On | When On, suggested feeds can appear in a user's activity feed. |

claims.claim: The notifications and feeds policy cmdlet documents only suggested-feeds and trending-feeds settings.
claims.quote:
Set-CsTeamsNotificationAndFeedsPolicy
    [-Description <String>]
    [[-Identity] <String>]
    [-SuggestedFeedsEnabledType <String>]
    [-TrendingFeedsEnabledType <String>]
    [-MsftInternalProcessingMode <String>]

claims.claim: The Graph call requires the Intune permission named in its reference.
claims.quote: One of the following permissions is required to call this API. ... Delegated (work or school account) | DeviceManagementApps.ReadWrite.All ... Application | DeviceManagementApps.ReadWrite.All

claims.claim: The displayed Microsoft Graph operation uses the beta API.
claims.quote: Microsoft supports Intune /beta APIs, but they are subject to more frequent change.

claims.claim: The displayed Graph policy object is for iOS/iPadOS, rather than an Android policy object.
claims.quote:
Update iosManagedAppProtection
Update the properties of a iosManagedAppProtection object.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.model, licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; Open questions
claims.claim: Feature-specific licensing is not published, so the briefing uses licensing model unknown.
claims.quote: Except for joining Teams meetings anonymously, each user in your organization must have a Teams license before they can use Teams.
claims.fix: Set licensing.model to 'included'. Set licensing.notes to 'Each user in the organization must have a Teams license before using Teams, except for joining meetings anonymously. No licence requirement specific to these channel notification presets is published.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoftteams/user-access in sources and use the same distinction in Cost and licensing and the licensing open question.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: Neither the roadmap record nor MC1388719 names a licence or meter for this feature.
claims.quote: No action is required. Recommendations: Inform helpdesk teams about this change ... Update internal documentation or training materials if you reference Teams notifications.

claims.where: Cost and licensing; Open questions; rationale: cost
claims.claim: Microsoft has not published a price or meter specific to these channel notification presets.
claims.quote: Searched: Microsoft Teams granular channel notification presets price meter licensing requirements. Opened Manage Teams licenses and Microsoft Teams service description; neither names a price or meter for these presets.

claims.where: front matter: cost; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: The known cost is indirect helpdesk, communication and training time, supporting the low cost rating.
claims.quote: Inform helpdesk teams about this change, as users may have questions about updated notification behavior. ... Update internal documentation or training materials if you reference Teams notifications.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not named an admin role that configures these presets.
claims.quote: Searched: Microsoft Teams channel notification presets admin role configure policy PowerShell. Opened Teams settings and policies reference, Set-CsTeamsNotificationAndFeedsPolicy and Set-CsTeamsChannelsPolicy; no admin preset control or role is specified.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not stated whether these new presets apply equally to standard, private and shared channels.
claims.quote: Searched: Teams channel notification presets shared; Teams granular channel notification presets All new messages Mentions replies Mute tenant policy admin licensing standard private shared. No result established the new presets' channel-type coverage.

claims.claim: Helpdesk communication and updating existing notification guidance are the entire preparation Microsoft recommends in this notice.
claims.quote: Recommendations: Inform helpdesk teams about this change, as users may have questions about updated notification behavior.- Update internal documentation or training materials if you reference Teams notifications.

claims.claim: Microsoft Learn does not yet describe this feature's new presets.
claims.quote: Searched: 565132; Teams granular notification policy; Teams channel notification administrator presets. Opened Teams settings and policies reference and configure-teams-mobile; neither describes the three new presets, and searches returned no feature documentation.
